title: Putin's famous Munich Speech 2007
summary: Vladimir Putin's February 2007 speech at the Munich Security Conference, criticizing a unipolar world and US use of force and NATO expansion. This upload presents the full speech with a sympathetic framing.
why: HN cites it as a primary source for Russia's grievances over NATO expansion, mostly in threads about Ukraine.

quote.text: I give you Putin's speech at the 2007 Munich Security Conference [1]
